findings.evidence: The only small-norm input is `Metric.continuousAt_iff.mp hreal.continuousAt` at line 66; for a semigroup, norm continuity at zero propagates to positive times, so requiring `Continuous` in the primitive theorem is stronger than the standard characterization.
findings.fix: First prove `domain_eq_top_of_continuousAt_zero (hS : ContinuousAt (fun t : NNReal ↦ S t) 0)` (deriving the needed local/global norm continuity from the semigroup law), then derive the current global-continuity theorem and equivalence as corollaries.
findings.issue: `domain_eq_top_of_continuous` is under-general: operator-norm continuity at zero suffices, while the proof immediately reduces `hS` to `continuousAt` at lines 64–66.

summary: The forward API assumes global operator-norm continuity although the semigroup characterization naturally requires only continuity at zero.
